name: legitimate-verification-code
description: False-positive resistance for the most ordinary transactional mail there is: a one-time code being delivered. It contains the exact phrase an OTP phish contains, and the sentence next to it — never share this code — is the opposite of the request the mfa_request rule reports. From a domain no brand table contains and with no dampening available, so nothing but the rule's own precision keeps it low.
